entries.title: Waring's problem
entries.exact_question: Let g(k) be the least s representing every n>=0 as at most s nonnegative kth powers. For every integer k>=2, is g(k)=2^k+floor((3/2)^k)-2? Separately determine G(k), the least s for all sufficiently large n; notably is G(3)=4?
